message: ――So, that’s the result of the Rock-Paper-Scissors Great War.
The one who won was Asahi.

name: Victoria
message: 「Not yet, I’m just getting started！」

name: Asahi
message: 「That’s what I was hoping for...！」
Against Victoria-san, who was landing blows one after another, Asahi focused on defense as expected, blocking each attack while slipping in counters in the intervals between.
Anticipating this, Victoria―san would either brace for defense or unleash attacks meant to draw out further counters, the two of them wearing down each other’s Barrier Jackets―
A battle like that had already been going on for about 20 minutes.

name: Victoria
message: 「Ugh~, Kuki-chan is so hard-core！ I can’t break through her at aaaaaall！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, that’s my strong point, after all...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, is this for real...？ I’ve never had a match go on this long.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「And on top of that, neither of them is even out of breath yet.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Asahi has a lot of stamina and is super tenacious, so it’s tough when she commits to defense like that.」

name: Momiji
message: 「No matter how hard you go at her, she doesn’t lose her pace, and it’s scary to think about eating a counter from her.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「She really does have incredible stamina and tenacity... well, Victoria-senpai is also amazing for attacking continuously like that the whole time.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, even pros call for a timeout after about 10 minutes, so if this keeps going, won’t they just wear out and end in a draw?」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, if this were a professional match, it would already be a draw by now.」

name: Iori
message: 「However, in the case of students—for example, at the Martial Festival, while there are timeouts, there are no draws. It’s just a rematch at a later date.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And yet the students seem like they’d have less stamina！」

name: Iori
message: 「Pros have the goal of ‘putting on a show,’ it’s show business after all. It’s a bit different from ‘deciding a winner’ like at the Martial Festival.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, but there’s a time limit for the facility usage this time, so if it stays like this, will it be a draw？」

name: Iori
message: 「...I wonder about that. I think the finish will come soon.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Then, I’ll just force my way through！」
Even while we were talking, the battle between the two of them continued.
It certainly looked like Asahi still had plenty of stamina left.
If you only consider the time, she could probably keep fighting even after a draw if she wanted to.
But that―is the same for Victoria―san as well.
Moreover, she is clearly exerting herself more than Asahi, who is focused on defense.
On top of having just fought Shizuku, she shows no signs of fatigue whatsoever, not even a hint of faltering.
Moreover, even though she should have taken countless hits from Asahi, her Barrier Jacket still has plenty to spare.

In contrast, although Asahi has certainly built up a sturdy defense, she could not fend off every single one of those successive blows―the sheer volume of them―and had a significant amount of her Barrier Jacket depleted.

name: Iori
message: （...Asahi is the one at a disadvantage in this damage race.）

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, Kuki-chan, how about something like this！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I-it’s not working...！」
I parry a sharp strike from the side and deflect it.
Victoria-senpai doesn't fight it, retreating once with nimble movements. Even so, there's no way she's going to give up now.
As if it were just the start of the match, Victoria-senpai wears an easygoing smile, wondering what she should do next.
I concentrate, preparing for the next attack—

name: Asahi
message: （...I fought her many times in the Yorishiro-kun simulator and managed to win back then, but... it really is completely different in a real fight...！）
The power, the speed, and the fighting style itself. Everything is happening beyond my expectations, and I can't help but offer a wry smile.
Though, that is also a stroke of luck.
If I had only known the information from Yorishiro-kun and faced her at the Martial Festival, I would have been quite surprised.
Being able to get real information at this stage is extremely significant.

name: Asahi
message: （Still... I have no idea how to deal with this...！）

name: Victoria
message: 「Alright, let's try something like this next！」

name: Asahi
message: （It's coming...！）
The distance of several meters shrinks to zero in an instant, and with that momentum, a razor-sharp barrage of attacks is unleashed.
I deflect the first strike while twisting my body, and firmly catch the second.
However, each one of Victoria―senpai's successive blows is abnormally heavy―
The slashes delivered from those dynamic, high-speed swings don't reflect on the Barrier Jacket, but every time I block one, the impact resonates deep into my arms.

name: Asahi
message: （Any ordinary academy student would probably be blown away right through their defense...！）
And since she’s been showering me with them continuously from the very start of the match, it's just too much to handle—

name: Victoria
message: 「Not over yet, not by a long shot！」
Contrary to her cheerful and bright voice, a ferocious barrage of attacks descends upon me.
But I was waiting for this too！
From a parry, straight into a strike while her stance is broken—！

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes！ Right there！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Kyauuu？！」
I thought I'd completely caught her off guard, only for an unexpected follow-up to come flying in, hitting me dead-on before I could even block.
Even so, there's no time to flinch now.
Managing to endure the impact, I step in toward Tennouji-senpai—whose stance really is broken this time！

name: Asahi
message: 「Ouitsu Issen！！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ngaaaaaah！！」
Taking a clean direct hit, Tennouji-senpai is sent flying far backward.
She rolls across the ground twice and comes to a halt down on one knee.

name: Victoria
message: 「Excellent...！ That was a good one, it really packed a punch！」

name: Asahi
message: 「You say that, yet you look pretty energetic...」
Stamina-wise, I still have plenty left in the tank too. My Barrier Jacket, however, was whittled down to its absolute limit by that last blow.
I can't afford another hit...！

name: Asahi
message: 「Just how many more hits will it take to bring you down?」

name: Victoria
message: 「Fufu~f, I think that goes for both of us, don't you~」
She really is absurdly tough. Still, I'm doing everything within my power.
Dodge her attacks, and land my own. All I have to do is keep repeating that until she goes down！

name: Victoria
message: 「Still, everyone looks like they're starting to get bored, so I'd better wrap this up soon！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「And make it super flashy, too！」
With that declaration, Tennouji-senpai takes a stance unlike any she's used so far.
No, I've seen that before—

name: Victoria
message: 「Watch and listen closely！ You insolent, outrageous, unhealthy scoundrels who dare oppose Lord Shogun！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Now that the great Okita-kun is here, I won't let you have your way！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Our Tennen Rishin-ryuu is the number one sword style under heaven！！」

name: Asahi
message: （That move is coming...！）

name: Victoria
message: 「Right now, I'm feeling... three katanas！」
Tennouji-senpai kicks off the ground and shoots toward me like a bullet！
I brace myself to defend—

name: Victoria
message: 「Time to get flashy！ Yuugen Mugen, Sonic Rush！！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'll block it all...！」
A blindingly fast flurry of thrusts bears down on me off a charge. I dodge, I parry, yet—

name: Asahi
message: （I can't keep up...！！）

name: Asahi
message: 「Kyaaaaaaaaah！！」
The final strike, looking like the most powerful of all, pierced straight into my body.
The impact sends me flying into the air for a brief moment... and feeling my Barrier Jacket give out, I come crashing down hard.

name: Iori
message: 「Match over！ That's enough！」

name: Asahi
message: （Ah... I lost right in front of Iori-san...）
Still sprawled on my back, I felt Iori-san come running over... and somehow, that made me feel both embarrassed and apologetic.
I have to get stronger—
